label: Figure 16.4: An inflationary gap in the new classical model
alt: LRAS at Yf, an upward-sloping SRAS and AD shifting right from AD1 to AD2. In the short run output rises to Y1 above Yf, marked as the inflationary gap.
caption: The economy starts at Yf where AD1, SRAS and LRAS all meet. AD then shifts right to AD2 (purple arrows). In the short run equilibrium moves along SRAS to output Y1, above Yf (price level P1 to P2). The excess of Y1 over Yf is the inflationary gap.
